name: jev
description: System One sweeps over the jev-latest model: ground text against sources, pick browser elements, tag mail and rows.

interface.shortDescription: Cheap sweeps over large bodies of text
interface.longDescription: jevchecker returns the parts of a large body worth reading against a nuanced criterion. The scripts folder holds the other sweeps (jevclick, jevmail, jevclassify, jevdrift) and the shared lib.
interface.defaultPrompt: Sweep this body for the parts worth reading.
